name: Machine Maiden
source:
Hero has only recently graduated and now he's been hired for a job. He is given the assignment to raise artificial intellect girl named Alia, but commonly known as Doll. What results can he attain in one month?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-february-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公才刚毕业便找到了一份工作。他接到任务，要培养名为阿尔西娅、通称“Doll”的人工智能少女。短短一个月内，他能取得怎样的成果？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-february-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
